jobs.title: Senior Director, Operations Finance
jobs.description:
Department
: Finance
Reports to:
Vice President, Business Finance
Status
: Full-time
Location:
Hybrid/Head office (10 Carlson Court, Etobicoke)

Purpose

Gay Lea is modernizing its finance function to better support enterprise decision-making, performance, and growth. This includes reducing manual reporting, strengthening planning processes, and leveraging improved tools and data capabilities.
This role is accountable for the financial performance of the manufacturing network, partnering with Operations to improve profitability through better manufacturing performance, asset utilization, and cost management.
The role owns costing methodology and manufacturing cost standards across the network and leads the plant controller community in delivering consistent financial visibility and performance management across all sites.
As a senior business partner to Operations leadership, the role converts plant and network data into operational decisions, surfaces cost and capacity trade-offs, and shifts site finance effort from reporting to decision support.

Key Responsibilities:

Partner with Operations to improve profitability through manufacturing performance, asset utilization, and cost management
Support manufacturing decisions through financial analysis of costs, productivity, capacity, and investments
Develop consistent costing methodologies, BOM governance, and manufacturing cost standards across the network
Lead financial visibility and performance management across manufacturing operations and site performance
Own the Finance contribution to the Supply Review within Integrated Business Planning (IBP), translating capacity, utilization, cost, and inventory decisions into financial outcomes
Evaluate operational trade-offs and support decisions that improve both financial and operational outcomes and communicate accordingly with other stakeholders
Monitor performance against commitments and identify risks, opportunities, and corrective actions
Partner with Operations to improve performance measurement, processes, tools, and operational insights
Lead, develop, and set standards for the plant controller team across the manufacturing network
Shift finance effort from reporting to decision support by leveraging data, tools, and improved ways of working

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in finance/accounting; CPA and/or MBA preferred
Proven finance leadership experience in Manufacturing, Operations Finance, or Plant Controllership environments
10+ years in finance with significant experience in cost accounting and multi-site manufacturing
Deep understanding of standard costing, BOM governance, variance analysis, and capital evaluation
Demonstrated ability to influence operating leaders and operate at the enterprise level
Experience leading distributed or multi-site finance teams
Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity and make meaningful trade-offs
Direct, pragmatic, and outcome-focused leadership style
Advanced financial, analytical, and systems capabilities

Gay Lea Foods is a Canadian, dairy farmer‑owned co‑operative with a clear purpose: to enrich life with dairy . Founded in 1958, the co‑operative produces high‑quality dairy products while creating lasting value for farming families, meaningful opportunities for employees, and positive impact in communities across Canada. As a co‑operative, Gay Lea Foods believes that when the business succeeds, its members, people, and communities should succeed along with it. To learn more, visit gaylea.com.
